scaffold.definition:
n. a platform from which criminals are executed (hanged or beheaded)
n. a temporary arrangement erected around a building for convenience of workers
v. provide with a scaffold for support
scaffold.translation:
n. 脚手架, 绞刑台
[化] 脚手架

scaffolded.definition: v provide with a scaffold for support
scaffolded.translation:
n. 脚手架；鹰架；绞刑台
vt. 给…搭脚手架；用支架支撑

scaffolding.translation:
n. 脚手架, 台架, (搭脚手架用的)支杆和木板, (喻)(论点等的)支柱
[化] 搭脚手架

scaffoldings.definition:
plural of scaffolding
n. a system of scaffolds
scaffoldings.translation:
(scaffolding 的复数) n. 脚手架, 台架, (搭脚手架用的)支杆和木板, (喻)(论点等的)支柱
[化] 搭脚手架

scaffolds.definition:
n a platform from which criminals are executed (hanged or beheaded)
n a temporary arrangement erected around a building for convenience of workers
v provide with a scaffold for support
scaffolds.translation: n. 脚手架( scaffold的名词复数 ); <史>断头台
